decision: Save all available reading text, source notes and artwork together; choose audio separately.
scope: The existing two-entry evaluation. No canonical source blocks, narration scripts, recording bytes or artwork changed.

additionalChecks: Canonical source equality and Arabic integrity hashes
All three pinned-source imports reproduced with --check

downloadModel.reading: All catalogued reading packs, local source notes, artwork and supporting app files. Approximately 2.8 MB in this release.
downloadModel.cedar: Existing continuous Hadith 1–2 recording, approximately 1.4 MB; requires reading.
downloadModel.comparisons: Optional existing delivery comparison recordings, approximately 2.0 MB; requires reading.
downloadModel.verification: Check byte length and SHA-256 before writing a new or reused file. Normal readiness checks presence and receipts; Check downloads rehashes bytes and removes corrupt cache entries. Exact release metadata and dependencies are required.
downloadModel.resume: Completed files are retained and reused after interruption. An incomplete individual file restarts.
downloadModel.cleanup: Only exact older Hadith reader release cache names are removed on explicit user action. Current release, personal storage, legacy pilot and other library caches are preserved.
downloadModel.concurrency: The active worker serializes operations. Audio removal checks relevant reader/review clients and refuses if playing or unresponsive.

browserObserved: Reading-only download became ready while Cedar remained not saved.
With the local server stopped, the reader reloaded, opened Hadith 2 and its source/Arabic view. All eight rendered source blocks matched canonical text exactly.
A Cedar save reused unchanged, hash-checked audio from an older reader download while the server was stopped.
Offline playback naturally crossed the 37.512-second Hadith 1–2 boundary; at 45.834 seconds it was still playing without an audio error and the reading view had followed to Hadith 2.
A second tab could not remove Cedar while the first played it at 58.297 seconds. After pausing, removal succeeded and reading remained ready.
An update retained Continue at Hadith 2 and the saved bookmark. Saving Cedar also saved required reading; optional comparisons stayed unselected.
Explicit old-cache cleanup preserved current reading and Cedar downloads. Removing Cedar preserved reading and personal state.
Saving audio with the server stopped did not mark it ready. Reconnecting allowed retry to succeed, followed by a successful deep Check downloads.
Day and night layouts fit 393px and 320px without horizontal overflow; night with the largest 28px reading setting was checked.
browserBuilds: Functional checks span candidates opening-ea994e8b416e, opening-cab8a6192cd4 and opening-3aef3d386b03. The final release also restores keyboard focus after Check downloads; final artifact smoke-check is recorded separately below.
limits: Desktop browser tests do not certify iPhone locked-screen/background behavior.
The revised reading/audio download flow needs iPhone acceptance.
Full-collection sizes and future per-session audio downloads have not been exercised by this two-entry sample.
Keep the app open while saving; the operating system may stop work or evict saved data.
Source translation and exact spoken-word/name review remain pending; these tests make no scholarly or audio approval claim.

platformReferences.use: Label storage estimates as origin-wide and approximate, handle quota errors, treat persistence as best effort and eviction as possible.
Use explicit named caches for releases and preserve unrelated caches.
Limit cleanup to exact older reader cache names.
Expose estimate and request persistence without treating either as an offline guarantee.
